$comment: Accepted findings of tools/lint-apps.ts, like rules/baselines/*.json of codegen 2.0: each entry is matched by file + detector + message (not by line); a new finding fails, and an entry that no longer matches fails too (remove it). Every entry says why it stays.

entries.reason: Document shell: inlines packages/ui/behaviors/theme-init.js in <head> (sets .dark before first paint, no flash). The script is a static repo file passed by cmd/export, not data.

Preview is a generated block component looked up in the packages/blocks registry by id, not a host tag; the Svelte twin (BlockPreview.svelte, <Preview {data} />) is a plain component to the svelte adapter. DOM parity with design-svelte is checked by tools/design-parity.ts.
The footer links are a nav landmark inside the footer Block; Block cannot nest, so it needs its own part file (NavBlock), which the blocks DSL cannot emit yet. Backlog blocks-dsl-no-part-files.md.
